name: Predictive Input Buffer
description: Source-only development revision: bounded cube/robot ground-input buffer. Exact wave prediction and complete Safe Mode protection remain unfinished. Test in Practice mode.

buffer-stage.name: Input Buffer Stage
buffer-stage.description: 1 = 2 ticks, 2 = 4 ticks, 3 = 8 ticks, 4 = 16 ticks (all) / 8 ticks (wave), 5 = Off (raw input).

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Master switch. This source revision only implements the ground-input buffer; exact wave prediction is not connected.

safe-mode.name: Safe Mode
safe-mode.description: ON: attempts where the mod changed your inputs do not save progress. OFF: progress saves normally even when the mod helped.

show-debug-overlay.name: Show Debug Overlay
show-debug-overlay.description: Show hook counters, queued/fired presses, assistance state, and unfinished protection/prediction status.
